run_densepose_evaluation: run DensePose COCO evaluation by creating DensePoseCocoEval with ground truth and detection COCO objects then calling evaluate
accumulate_densepose_results: accumulate per-image per-category DensePose evaluation results into precision and recall arrays using the accumulate method
summarize_densepose_metrics: summarize DensePose evaluation metrics including AP and AR at various OGPS thresholds and area ranges using summarize
compute_ogps_iou: compute OGPS scores between detections and ground truth by calling computeOgps for a given image and category ID
configure_densepose_params: configure DensePose evaluation parameters such as IoU thresholds, recall thresholds, and max detections using the Params class
